subject: The column your providers don't fill
body:
Newsletter publication data is a column set none of the providers returns: the publication itself, its audience and the basis for that figure, the topics it covers, the sponsors running in it, and whether it is gaining readers.

NewsletterFIT derives those from the issues, with AI reading each one, and adds article level attribution so a row can say which piece a fact came from, plus the article text where a publisher's terms allow it.

Where the category already sits: Clay in 92 articles across 56 publications, Apollo in 102 across 88, while People Data Labs and Clearbit register once each.

I can send a sample keyed by domain so the join is testable before a connector exists.
